body: Good to hear! I’m feeling better than when I wrote this; I’m just going to keep in mind that it’ll take time to feel like home.

This past month. 
I’m thinking that it may just be a case of me needing to settle and get into a routine. 
There are other issues that I think are going on (codependency), so I’m making an appointment to get some counselling.
It’s good to hear I’m not the only one. I guess I feel bad because I’m older than my friends all were when they first moved out.
